event_facts.headline: NFP ژوئیه: -23K در برابر حدود +80K انتظار؛ unemployment=4.1%؛ AHE YoY=3.2%؛ revisions دو ماه قبل=-103K.
event_facts.interpretation: فکت غالب، cooling واقعی بازار کار و کاهش فشار برای hike سپتامبر است؛ اما افت unemployment ناشی از کاهش 264K نفری labor force و participation=61.4% مانع از خوانش ساده «رکود» می‌شود. private payroll +30K بوده و بخش مهم افت headline از local-government education (-50K) آمده است.
event_facts.transmission: بعد از انتشار، Treasury yields و USD افت کردند و Nasdaq-100 futures تا حدود +0.8% بالا رفت؛ این ترکیب فعلاً روایت rate-relief-without-confirmed-recession را فعال کرده است. در FX انتقال یکدست نیست و USDJPY مقاومت کرده است.
event_facts.session: Cutoff تقریباً 10 دقیقه بعد از NFP و حدود 50 دقیقه پیش از Cash Open آمریکا است؛ بنابراین liquidity/price-discovery هنوز pre-cash و event-adjacent است.

XAUUSD.edge_reason: NFP، revisions و wages همگی نرخ/دلار را به نفع طلا هل می‌دهند و driverهای ساختاری نیز مثبت‌اند؛ اما حرکت هفتگی نزدیک 7% مصرف شده و quote قابل‌اتکای post-NFP برای تأیید price-control خود XAU در cutoff عمومی موجود نیست.
XAUUSD.context: Spot gold پیش از NFP حدود $4,326.59 و نزدیک 7% بالاتر در هفته بود. قیمت‌گذاری post-release عمومی بین منابع ناهمگون است؛ بنابراین عدد دقیق پس از خبر را به‌عنوان واقعیت استفاده نمی‌کنیم.

horizons.MICRO 0–15m: صعودی از منظر driver، ولی price-control مستقیم XAU هنوز fully verified نیست.
horizons.SHORT 15–60m: صعودی مشروط؛ اگر افت 2Y/USD پایدار بماند و XAU spike را حفظ کند، edge قابلیت فعال شدن دارد.
horizons.SESSION 1–6h: صعودی با reversal hazard بالا به‌علت consumption زیاد و cash-open risk.
horizons.DAILY: صعودی؛ labor cooling + geopolitics + reserve diversification همسو هستند.
horizons.NEXT_24H: صعودی/پرریسک؛ Friday close و ریسک weekend geopolitical gap می‌تواند تقاضای پناهگاه را حفظ کند.
horizons.2–5D: صعودی متوسط، اما به CPI و بازقیمت‌گذاری واقعی Fed حساس و پس از rally بزرگ شکننده‌تر است.

XAUUSD.facts: NFP -23K، revisions -103K، AHE +3.2% YoY و تقریباً flat MoM؛ Treasury/USD بعد از داده پایین. PBOC در ژوئیه خرید طلا را شتاب داد. Gold ETFs در ژوئیه +$3bn / +23t و holdings=4,068t داشتند.
XAUUSD.forces: نیروی موافق: lower expected Fed path، USD/yields down، geopolitical safe-haven، central-bank demand، ETF inflow. نیروی مخالف: 10Y هنوز structurally بالا، oil/inflation risk، rally هفتگی شدید، احتمال profit-taking و cash-open de-risking.
XAUUSD.driver: ACTIVE DRIVER = dovish labor repricing از revisions + weak payroll + softer wages. AVAILABLE but not sole active = geopolitics/official-sector demand. این عوامل double-count نشده‌اند: rates/USD کانال causal خبرند؛ PBOC/ETF confirmation مستقل ساختاری است.
XAUUSD.narrative: روایت غالب: «labor cooling → Fed hike probability lower → opportunity cost gold lower». Challenger: «unemployment 4.1 + oil inflation → Fed هنوز مجبور به سختگیری؛ rally بیش‌مصرف شده». Validity بالا، dominance متوسط-بالا، price-control مستقیم post-NFP نامشخص، persistence بنیادی بالا، saturation بالا، fragility متوسط-بالا.
XAUUSD.consumption: fact persistence بالا؛ narrative persistence متوسط-بالا؛ consumption بالا (هفته نزدیک +7% پیش از خبر)؛ remaining pressure مثبت ولی کمتر از اندازه surprise headline؛ reversal hazard بالا.
XAUUSD.flows: ETF monthly flow مثبت و official-sector demand مثبت. داده live COMEX positioning، dealer gamma، OTC physical flow و precise intraday real-yield در دسترس نیست؛ confidence cap اعمال شده است.
XAUUSD.scenarios: Base: yields/USD پایین می‌مانند و XAU price-control تأیید می‌شود → upgrade ACTIVE BUY. Bull extension: cash open هم rate-relief را می‌پذیرد. Failure: 2Y/DXY reclaim یا XAU نتواند post-NFP bid را حفظ کند → BIAS_ONLY/NO_EDGE.
XAUUSD.invalidation: Causal invalidation: بازگشت 2Y و USD به بالای pre-release regime. Narrative invalidation: بازار unemployment 4.1%/oil را hawkish reinterpret کند. Transmission invalidation: XAU خلاف rates/USD عمل کند. Liquidity invalidation: post-event whipsaw/large spread. Time invalidation: 16:40.
XAUUSD.learning: Prior persistent call: BULLISH / EDGE_CONDITIONAL / NO_TRADE. Pre-event strength با جهت prior سازگار بود. Classification: CORRECT_DIRECTION؛ POSSIBLE_OVER_VETO هنوز حل‌نشده چون start-path دقیق و علت دقیق conditional در archive کافی نیست. MFE/MAE قابل اتکا موجود نیست.
why_not_active: 1) عدم تأیید مستقل و قابل‌اتکای price-control خود XAU پس از خبر در cutoff.
2) consumption بسیار بالا پس از rally هفتگی نزدیک 7%، که asymmetry ورود تازه را ضعیف می‌کند.
احتیاط غیرقطعی: geopolitics و Friday/weekend می‌تواند هم safe-haven bid و هم liquidation ایجاد کند.
داده کمبود: live spot path/MFE-MAE، real-yield intraday، COMEX dealer positioning و spread/liquidity broker-level.
Upgrade: XAU post-release direction را حفظ کند + 2Y/DXY پایین بمانند + second impulse مخالف headline شکل نگیرد → EDGE_ACTIVE BUY.
Downgrade: بازگشت USD/2Y و شکست transmission XAU → BIAS_ONLY/NO_EDGE؛ whipsaw شدید → EVENT_OR_FRAGMENTED.
NFP دیگر event veto نیست؛ release انجام شده. اکنون فقط post-event stabilization/quality constraint مطرح است.
Usable window پس از upgrade فقط تا 16:40، سپس state منقضی و قبل/بعد cash-open بازبینی می‌شود.
Blocker 1 با quote قابل اتکای XAU و حفظ post-release bid رفع می‌شود؛ blocker 2 با consolidation بدون reversal و remaining pressure قابل مشاهده کاهش می‌یابد.
بله، opportunity صعودی بعد از خبر ممکن است وجود داشته باشد؛ فعلاً به‌علت evidence-quality و consumption از Permission خودداری شده است.

NASDAQ100.edge_reason: rate-sensitive NQ بعد از shock اشتغال قوی‌ترین index future است (~+0.8%)؛ yields/USD پایین و earnings/guidance tech تازه همسو هستند. این فقط spike headline نیست؛ driver و transmission در چند کانال مستقل هم‌جهت‌اند.
NASDAQ100.context: NQ futures پیش از خبر نیز مثبت بود و پس از NFP به حدود +0.8% رسید. Cash market هنوز باز نشده؛ بنابراین state به futures/pre-cash محدود و validity window کوتاه است.

horizons.MICRO 0–15m: صعودی و coherent؛ NQ leadership همراه افت rates/USD.
horizons.SHORT 15–60m: صعودی؛ best current edge تا قبل از cash-open، مگر 2Y/DXY/NQ reversal.
horizons.SESSION 1–6h: صعودی مشروط به cash breadth؛ growth-scare transition بزرگ‌ترین ریسک است.
horizons.DAILY: صعودی ملایم تا متوسط؛ earnings بسیار قوی و lower-rate repricing حمایت می‌کنند.
horizons.NEXT_24H: صعودی-خنثی؛ Friday close و weekend headline risk.
horizons.2–5D: صعودی مشروط؛ CPI و real-rate path تعیین‌کننده و valuation/concentration ریسک محدودکننده.

NASDAQ100.facts: NFP -23K و revisions -103K در کنار AHE 3.2% فشار نرخ را کم کرد. S&P Q2 blended earnings +47.4%، حتی ex Alphabet/Amazon +28.8%. Fresh guidance در software/chips مثبت بود؛ NQ post-NFP ~+0.8%.
NASDAQ100.forces: موافق: lower yields/Fed hike odds، strong earnings/revisions، AI/software/chip guidance، relative leadership. مخالف: high valuation/duration sensitivity، AI skepticism، growth-fund outflow، cash breadth هنوز دیده نشده، oil/geopolitics.
NASDAQ100.driver: ACTIVE = rate-relief from labor cooling، تقویت‌شده توسط earnings/guidance. Earnings confirmation مستقل است؛ افت yields کانال causal NFP است و NQ rise transmission است—این سه یک driver واحد double-count نشده‌اند.
NASDAQ100.narrative: Dominant: «cooling enough to ease Fed, not yet recessionary enough to kill earnings». Challenger: «jobs cliff → growth scare». Validity بالا، dominance بالا در futures، price control بالا، persistence کوتاه‌مدت متوسط-بالا، saturation متوسط، fragility متوسط به cash open.
NASDAQ100.consumption: NFP surprise تازه و کم‌مصرف؛ earnings narrative چندروزه و بخشی مصرف‌شده. Remaining pressure مثبت در کوتاه‌مدت. Reversal hazard متوسط؛ اگر cash market growth scare را انتخاب کند سریع بالا می‌رود.
NASDAQ100.flows: US equity funds هفته اخیر -$1.58b و growth funds -$5.5b؛ tech inflows به six-week low رسید. بنابراین rally فعلی flow-tailwind سنتی ندارد و بیشتر fresh repricing است. Live options gamma/CTA positioning/breadth pre-cash کامل در دسترس نیست.
NASDAQ100.scenarios: Base: 2Y/USD پایین، NQ leadership حفظ → ACTIVE BUY تا expiry. Upside: cash breadth tech/software/chips همسو → state قابل تمدید. Failure: NQ gains giveback + 2Y/DXY reclaim یا cash-open breadth collapse → immediate downgrade.
NASDAQ100.invalidation: Driver: Fed-hike odds/yields دوباره بالا. Transmission: NQ relative leadership از بین برود. Narrative: growth scare بر rate relief غالب شود. Flow: broad risk-off/VIX shock. Time: 16:40.
NASDAQ100.learning: Prior persistent call: MILD_BEARISH / BIAS_ONLY / NO_TRADE. Pre-event NQ مثبت بود و حالا post-NFP leadership واضح است. Classification: WRONG_DIRECTION / NARRATIVE_MISREAD با DATA_LIMITATION درباره start-price؛ permission NO_TRADE قبلی هنوز false permission نبود. Candidate: localized AI sell-the-news نباید بدون index breadth/relative-leadership confirmation به کل NDX تعمیم یابد.

SP500.edge_reason: rate relief و earnings breadth مثبت‌اند، اما cash breadth هنوز باز نشده و NQ واضحاً driver sensitivity بیشتری دارد؛ برای ES/SPX evidence اختصاصی کافی جهت ACTIVE نداریم.
SP500.context: S&P futures پیش از NFP مثبت بود؛ بعد از گزارش broader US futures بالا رفتند. Cash open 17:00 Tehran است.

horizons.MICRO 0–15m: صعودی اما confirmation اختصاصی کمتر از NQ.
horizons.SHORT 15–60m: صعودی مشروط؛ نیازمند حفظ ES bid و عدم تبدیل labor-cooling به growth-scare.
horizons.SESSION 1–6h: خنثی-صعودی تا cash breadth روشن شود.
horizons.DAILY: صعودی ملایم؛ earnings breadth و rate relief همسو.
horizons.2–5D: صعودی مشروط به CPI/rates؛ valuation و oil headwinds پابرجا.

SP500.facts: S&P Q2 blended earnings +47.4%; ex Alphabet/Amazon +28.8%, پس profit growth فقط یک mega-cap illusion نیست. NFP weak و yields/USD down، اما weekly equity fund flow آمریکا -$1.58b است.
SP500.forces: موافق: lower rates، strong earnings across sectors، positive global equity flows. مخالف: growth-scare risk، US fund outflow، high valuation، oil/geopolitics، pre-cash breadth unknown.
SP500.driver: AVAILABLE/ACTIVE partially = rate relief. Earnings background قوي. اما price-control اختصاصی SP500 نسبت به NQ کمتر تفکیک‌پذیر است؛ correlation با NQ confirmation مکانیکی تلقی شده و double-count نشده.
SP500.narrative: Dominant candidate: soft-landing/rate relief. Challenger: labor deterioration broadens into earnings/growth downgrade. Validity medium-high، dominance medium، price-control medium pre-cash، saturation medium، fragility medium-high.
SP500.consumption: NFP fresh، earnings partly consumed، remaining pressure positive but weaker than NQ; reversal hazard medium.
SP500.flows: US equity fund outflows contrast with global +$21.15b equity inflows. Live breadth, dealer gamma, CTA and passive rebalance not fully observable before cash open.
SP500.scenarios: Upgrade if ES itself maintains post-NFP bid and cash breadth across multiple sectors confirms. Downgrade if growth-sensitive sectors reject or yields/USD reverse.
SP500.invalidation: 2Y/DXY reversal، ES giveback independent of NQ، cash breadth negative، VIX/liquidity stress، expiry 16:40.
SP500.learning: Prior persistent call NEUTRAL / NO_EDGE / NO_TRADE. تا event، نبود edge broad-market قابل دفاع بود؛ post-event transition تازه است. Classification: CORRECT_STATE / EVENT_RESET; MFE/MAE unavailable.
why_not_active: 1) cash breadth/sector participation هنوز مشاهده نشده؛ شاخص می‌تواند صرفاً از NQ/mega-cap correlation حمایت بگیرد.
2) weak labor data دو روایت متضاد rate-relief و growth-scare را برای broad index زنده نگه می‌دارد.
احتیاط غیرقطعی: US equity fund outflow و valuation بالا.
کمبود: live advance/decline، sector breadth، dealer gamma/CTA و precise post-release ES path.
Upgrade: ES bid مستقل + multi-sector breadth مثبت + yields/USD پایین → EDGE_ACTIVE BUY.
Downgrade: growth sectors/financials/industrials فروش بگیرند یا ES gains را پس بدهد → BIAS_ONLY/NO_EDGE؛ whipsaw → EVENT_OR_FRAGMENTED.
NFP دیگر veto نیست؛ cash-open یک session-transition risk و validity constraint است.
Current usable analysis window تا 16:40؛ cash-open 17:00 نیازمند reset.
Blocker breadth با cash sector participation و ES relative strength رفع می‌شود.
بله، opportunity pre-cash ممکن است باشد، اما evidence اختصاصی SP500 برای Permission هنوز پایین‌تر از threshold است.

DJIA.edge_reason: Dow از rate relief حمایت می‌گیرد، اما labor weakness برای cyclical/financial exposure تهدید مستقیم‌تری است و relative leadership همچنان به NQ تعلق دارد؛ مزیت فعلی بیشتر relative است تا directional absolute.
DJIA.context: Dow price-weighted و نسبت به NQ tech-duration کمتری دارد. قبل از خبر lagging بود؛ بعد از shock نیز leadership به NQ رسیده است.

horizons.2–5D: خنثی؛ اگر labor weakness پایدار شود cyclical drag، اگر rates dominate شود relief.

DJIA.facts: Weak payroll/revisions lowers rates but also questions cyclicals. Fund flows favored value +$1.99b and industrials recently, which is counter-force to relative weakness.
DJIA.forces: موافق absolute: rate relief، value/industrial fund inflow. مخالف relative: labor/growth sensitivity، weaker earnings-duration leverage than NQ، financial activity jobs -14K.
DJIA.driver: No clean absolute active driver. Relative driver = rate-relief disproportionately benefits duration tech vs price-weighted Dow. This is a relative-value observation only.
DJIA.narrative: Dominant relative narrative: NQ benefits more from dovish rates; challenger: rotation to value/industrials if growth holds. Dominance medium, fragility high until cash open.
DJIA.consumption: Relative leadership evidence fresh; remaining pressure medium; reversal hazard high if cash rotation turns toward value.
DJIA.flows: Value funds +$1.99b and industrial sector inflows are supportive, so bearish-relative case is not one-sided. Options/systematic data limited.
DJIA.scenarios: If NQ keeps outperforming with yields lower → EDGE_RELATIVE persists. If breadth rotates into industrials/value → NO_EDGE. Absolute SELL is not approved.
DJIA.invalidation: Dow catches/exceeds NQ leadership, financial/industrial breadth strong, yields rise but growth holds, or cash rotation changes.
DJIA.learning: Prior persistent call MILD_BEARISH_RELATIVE_WEAKNESS / EDGE_RELATIVE. NQ has led Dow both into and just after event. Classification: CORRECT_RELATIVE_STATE; exact path proxy only, no MFE/MAE.

EURUSD.edge_reason: US labor surprise materially reduces near-term Fed-hike pressure while euro-area inflation/GDP keep ECB tightening risk alive, but immediate EURUSD price transmission is not strong enough/cleanly sourced to declare ACTIVE.
EURUSD.context: EURUSD was ~1.1528 pre-NFP. Broad USD fell after data, but a reliable minute-by-minute EURUSD path at cutoff is not available in the public source set.

horizons.MICRO 0–15m: bullish fundamental impulse, price confirmation incomplete.
horizons.SHORT 15–60m: bullish conditional if US 2Y/DXY stay lower and EURUSD gains persist.
horizons.SESSION 1–6h: bullish bias; ECB-Fed expected differential narrows.
horizons.2–5D: bullish conditional; July CPI next week can reverse USD rates quickly.

EURUSD.facts: Fed target 3.50–3.75%; ECB deposit 2.25%. Euro-area July inflation 2.9%, core 2.5%; Q2 GDP +0.4%. NFP shock/revisions/wages lower expected US path. Current nominal carry still favors USD substantially.
EURUSD.forces: EUR+: Fed repricing dovish, ECB still hike-risk, euro growth better than feared. EUR-: current carry still USD-positive, oil terms-of-trade negative for euro area, dollar safe-haven/geopolitics, live basis/hedging unknown.
EURUSD.driver: Potential ACTIVE driver = relative policy repricing, but instrument activation incomplete. US labor news is causal; ECB inflation/GDP is independent bilateral confirmation; broad USD decline is transmission confirmation.
EURUSD.narrative: Dominant candidate: Fed path converges lower relative to ECB. Challenger: energy inflation/global risk revives USD haven and harms euro terms of trade. Dominance medium, price control medium-low, persistence medium, fragility medium-high.
EURUSD.consumption: US labor surprise fresh; euro-side facts older/partly consumed. Remaining pressure positive but needs spot confirmation; reversal hazard medium.
EURUSD.flows: No reliable live EURUSD funding-basis, hedging, real-money or CFTC intraday data. Explicit confidence cap.
EURUSD.scenarios: Upgrade on persistent EURUSD appreciation + DXY/2Y lower without risk-off USD haven. Downgrade if DXY reclaims, oil/geopolitics spike, or EURUSD ignores favorable spread move.
EURUSD.invalidation: 2Y/DXY reversal، euro-specific risk-off، oil shock، spot non-confirmation، expiry 16:40.
EURUSD.learning: Prior persistent call MILD_BEARISH / BIAS_ONLY. Pre-event EURUSD was near 1.1528 and mostly rangebound; exact start path unavailable. Classification: UNRESOLVED / DATA_LIMITATION. NFP at 16:00 creates a new regime, so post-event move is not used to retroactively score prior evidence.
why_not_active: 1) pair-specific price-control after release is not sufficiently verified; broad DXY down is not enough.
2) USD still owns a large nominal carry advantage despite reduced hike odds.
Caution: oil/geopolitics can damage euro terms of trade and revive USD haven.
Missing: live EURUSD path, short-end US-vs-Germany spread at minute frequency, basis/hedging and real-money flows.
Upgrade: EURUSD sustained upside + US2Y/DXY lower + no risk-off USD demand → EDGE_ACTIVE BUY.
Downgrade: pair fails to rise despite favorable rates or DXY reverses → BIAS_ONLY/NO_EDGE; disorderly chop → EVENT_OR_FRAGMENTED.
NFP release is no longer a veto. Cash-open is only a validity/review constraint.
Usable state until 16:40; re-adjudicate before/after 17:00 cash open.
Pair-specific quote/relative front-end spread and persistent spot follow-through remove blocker 1.
بله، pre-cash EUR upside may exist, but evidence quality remains below ACTIVE threshold.

USDJPY.edge_reason: Weak US labor, lower US yields, BOJ hike risk and recent coordinated intervention all favor JPY; yet USDJPY has shown stubborn resistance around 158 and pair-specific transmission is incomplete, so SELL is withheld.
USDJPY.context: USDJPY ~158.29 pre-NFP after recovering substantially from intervention-driven yen strength. Recent US-Japan intervention creates nonlinear jump risk in both direction and liquidity.

horizons.MICRO 0–15m: bearish fundamental impulse but spot confirmation weak.
horizons.SHORT 15–60m: bearish conditional if US-Japan front-end spread compresses and pair finally follows.
horizons.SESSION 1–6h: bearish bias with high intervention/whipsaw risk.
horizons.NEXT_24H: bearish-mild into weekend, but carry remains strong counterforce.
horizons.2–5D: bearish conditional on BOJ/Fed convergence; oil/import-cost pressure and carry can re-support USDJPY.

USDJPY.facts: Fed 3.50–3.75 vs BOJ 1% leaves sizable carry. BOJ held 1% but signaled possibility of early hike; recent coordinated intervention explicitly supports yen. NFP/revisions now reduce US short-rate pressure. Japan is energy importer; oil risk is JPY negative.
USDJPY.forces: JPY+: lower US yields, BOJ hawkish risk, intervention threat. USDJPY+: still-large carry, weak-yen structural positioning, oil/import terms-of-trade hit to Japan, potential USD haven.
USDJPY.driver: Potential active = spread compression; however spot transmission break is decisive. Intervention is independent asymmetric risk, not confirmation of ordinary carry reversal.
USDJPY.narrative: Dominant candidate: policy convergence/intervention caps USDJPY. Challenger: carry remains king and jobs weakness not enough to erase differential. Dominance medium, price control low-medium, fragility high.
USDJPY.consumption: Intervention narrative several days old/partly consumed; NFP fresh. Remaining bearish pressure positive but unproven in pair. Reversal/whipsaw hazard high.
USDJPY.flows: No reliable live basis, exporter hedging, options barriers or MoF flow data. Intervention makes public spot quotes insufficient to infer positioning.
USDJPY.scenarios: Upgrade SELL if USDJPY weakens persistently while US2Y falls and intervention/BOJ narrative remains live. Downgrade if pair ignores falling US yields and reclaims upside → BIAS_ONLY/NO_EDGE.
USDJPY.invalidation: US yields rebound، carry widens، pair refuses to follow DXY lower، oil spike hurts JPY، sudden intervention/liquidity disorder → fragmented.
USDJPY.learning: Prior persistent call BULLISH / EDGE_CONDITIONAL / NO_TRADE. Pre-event pair recovered to ~158.29 after intervention, broadly compatible with carry direction; no-trade was prudent. Classification: CORRECT_DIRECTION / CORRECT_VETO_LOGIC, then EVENT_RESET at NFP. Exact MFE/MAE unavailable.
why_not_active: 1) decisive blocker: pair-specific transmission break—USDJPY has not clearly followed broad USD/yield weakness.
2) still-large Fed–BOJ nominal carry makes immediate downside asymmetry less clean.
Caution: Japan energy-import terms of trade and volatile intervention regime.
Missing: live front-end spread, options barriers/gamma, exporter hedging and confirmed minute spot path.
Upgrade: sustained USDJPY downside + US2Y lower + no rapid reversal → EDGE_ACTIVE SELL.
Downgrade: USDJPY rises despite lower US yields or carry re-widens → BIAS_ONLY/NO_EDGE; intervention chop → EVENT_OR_FRAGMENTED.
NFP itself is over, not a veto; intervention/liquidity can be a TRUE VETO if disorder appears.
Usable state until 16:40; cash-open review 17:05.
A clean pair decline consistent with front-end spread compression removes blocker 1.
بله، bearish opportunity may exist, but current non-confirmation means it is withheld.
